ids: categorical; use embeddings, never infer numerical ordering
powers: player followed by up to six living enemies; each row contains native buff type ID and amount
piles: draw, discard, exhaust; unordered compositions, never hidden order
known_order: known top, known bottom; top-to-bottom within each section
padding: zero card/enemy/relic IDs indicate padding; legal actions use explicit mask
bounds: 10 hand cards, 64 cards per pile, 6 enemies, 16 powers per creature, 8 relics, 64 actions; overflow fails explicitly
extension_rule: Enchantment identities, additional resources and selection screens need a versioned encoding extension before enabling corresponding content.
intent_visibility: Attacks expose displayed total damage and hit count. StatusCard exposes the displayed card count with zero hits. Other non-damage intents expose type only; zero magnitude/hits are unavailable placeholders.
